name: Decorom
tagline: Handcrafted Luxury Designer Nameplates for Homes, Flats & Villas
description: Decorom is a premier designer nameplate manufacturer and e-commerce brand based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Specializing in handcrafted custom nameplates in Acrylic, Natural Teak Wood, Weatherproof ACP, Laser-cut Mild Steel, SS 304 Stainless Steel, and Hand-Poured Resin Art with real-time 2D/3D customizer and pan-India doorstep delivery.

physicalStore.address: Shop A/7, Second Floor, Shreekunj Shopping Centre, Near HDFC Bank, K.K. Nagar, Ghatlodiya, Nirnay Nagar

fulfillment.productionTime: Ready within 2–3 working days from design approval
fulfillment.deliveryAhmedabad: Next-day doorstep delivery across Ahmedabad & Gandhinagar
fulfillment.deliveryPanIndia: 4–6 working days express courier shipping with live tracking across all Indian states
fulfillment.packaging: Multi-layer shockproof thermocol and corrugated protective box

customizerFeatures.interactivePreview: Real-time 2D/3D visual customizer with live typography, dimensions, and colorway rendering
